key.name: window-width
key.summary: Window width

key.name: window-height
key.summary: Window height

key.name: is-maximized
key.summary: Window maximized state

key.name: sidebar-pinned
key.summary: Whether the sidebar is pinned

key.name: player
key.summary: The player to use

key.name: downloader
key.summary: The downloader to use

key.name: download-format
key.summary: The default format for downloading videos.

key.name: download-yt-dlp-arguments
key.summary: Additional yt-dlp arguments.

key.name: enable-source-youtube
key.summary: Let Pipeline fetch videos from YouTube

key.name: piped-url
key.summary: The piped api url

key.name: piped-automatically-manage-instances
key.summary: Automatically manage Piped instances.

key.name: piped-api-urls
key.summary: The piped api urls

key.name: youtube-mode
key.summary: How to query data from YouTube; can be either "rustyipe", "piped", "rustypipe-then-piped", or "piped-then-rustypipe" (with potential future values reserved for in the future).

key.name: enable-source-peertube
key.summary: Let Pipeline fetch videos from PeerTube

key.name: peertube-search-api
key.summary: The peertube api used for searches

key.name: search-source
key.summary: Which source the Search page shows results from: "all", "youtube" or "peertube".

key.name: only-videos-yesterday
key.summary: Only show videos of yesterday.

key.name: remove-short-videos
key.summary: Remove short videos.

key.name: remove-requires-payment
key.summary: Remove videos which require payment.

key.name: remove-watched
key.summary: Remove videos which have already been watched.

key.name: filter-enabled
key.summary: Whether the filter is enabled.

key.name: watch-history-enabled
key.summary: Whether the application keeps the history of watched videos.

key.name: last-added-platform
key.summary: The type of platform for which the last subscription was added.

key.name: reload-on-startup
key.summary: Whether to reload when starting the application.

key.name: play-external-default
key.summary: Whether to play with the external player by default.

key.name: show-splash
key.summary: Whether to show the splash text when reloading the feed.

key.name: seasonal-style
key.summary: Whether to apply seasonal styling to the application, based on annual celebrations (e.g. pride month).

key.name: setup-window-shown
key.summary: Whether the setup window was already shown.

key.name: cairo-software-renderer
key.summary: Whether cairo should be used for rendering.

key.name: player-volume
key.summary: Stores last volume value to apply on startup

key.name: player-speed
key.summary: Stores last speed value to apply on startup

key.name: player-subtitles-enabled
key.summary: Stores whether subtitles are enabled value to apply on startup

key.name: player-adaptive-start-bitrate
key.summary: Stores initial adaptive streaming bitrate to apply on startup

key.name: account-cookies-command
key.summary: Command that prints the path to a Netscape cookies.txt of the YouTube account used for Home, Up next and watch history. Empty (the default) means no account: fully anonymous.

key.name: account-label
key.summary: How the connected YouTube account is shown, e.g. "hellyeah · Chromium"

key.name: fast-start
key.summary: Experimental: start YouTube videos with Kinora's own stream lookup (RustyPipe) instead of yt-dlp. Off: with RustyPipe 0.11.4 only the iOS client still works, and YouTube refuses its links (403) past the first megabyte without a PO token.

key.name: autoplay-next
key.summary: Play the first Up next video when a video ends

key.name: disabled-extensions
key.summary: Extensions that are switched off, by id ('account', 'home-chips', ...). All others are on.

key.name: extension-settings
key.summary: The extensions' settings, keyed 'EXTENSION.SETTING' (e.g. 'account.mark-watched'): booleans for toggles, strings for choices and text. Missing keys use the extension's default.

key.name: first-run-done
key.summary: Whether "How do you want to watch?" was shown (it comes up once, on the first launch).

key.name: reduce-effects
key.summary: Lite: switch off the ambient glow, hover effects, motion and preparing videos on hover.
